resources.description: Rows of the timeline, for example people or rooms

events.description: Bars placed on the rows by resourceId, start and end. Overlapping bars of a row are placed in separate lanes

startDate.description: First day shown on the timeline

endDate.description: Last day shown on the timeline

dayWidth.description: Width of one day in pixels

laneHeight.description: Height of one lane of bars in pixels

resourceWidth.description: Width of the sticky resource column

height.description: Height of the component. The body scrolls inside it

markers.description: Vertical dashed lines on given dates, for example milestones

allowResourceChange.description: Allows dragging a bar to another row (and moving it with the up / down arrow keys)

showToday.description: Highlights today in the header and draws a line on every row

isNonWorkingDay.description: Shades the days a resource does not work, per row

resourceTemplate.description: Custom content of the resource column

dayCellTemplate.description: Renders a row of day cells under the bars of each resource, for example the daily load

dayCellHeight.description: Height of the day cell row

emptyMessage.description: Shown when there are no resources

className.description: Additional CSS class of the root element

onEventChange.description: Called after a bar is moved, resized or moved to another row, with the new start, end and resource

onEventClick.description: Called when a bar is clicked without being dragged

onEventDoubleClick.description: Called on double click or Enter on a bar

onExternalDrop.description: Enables dropping items dragged with the HTML drag and drop API onto a row. Receives the row, the day and the dataTransfer

title.description: Label and tooltip of the bar

draggable.description: Set to false to prevent moving the bar

resizable.description: Set to false to prevent resizing the bar

data.description: Any data used by the templates
